exercises.name: 1. Skip Rope or Fast March in Place
exercises.notes: Light pulse raise. Stay relaxed through shoulders and bounce softly.

exercises.name: 2. Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch, hip circles, thoracic rotations, ankle rocks. Move smoothly.

exercises.name: 3. Pogo Jumps
exercises.notes: Quick ankle stiffness. Stay tall, short ground contact, quiet landings.

exercises.name: 4. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Jump far with full intent. Stick the landing and reset each rep.

exercises.name: 5a. Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Controlled down, stand up fast. Keep chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: 5b. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Stop 1–2 reps before form breaks. Straight line from head to heel.

exercises.name: 6a. Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Step back under control. Light tap on the floor, drive through front foot.

exercises.name: 6b. Prone Y-T-W Raises
exercises.notes: Lift arms with control. Keep neck relaxed and squeeze upper back.

exercises.name: 7a. Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Pause 1 second at the top. Do not overarch the lower back.

exercises.name: 7b. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Straight body line. Squeeze glutes and keep hips high.

exercises.name: 8a. V-Up or Bent-Knee Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Use the harder version only if you can stay controlled.

exercises.name: 8b. Neck Isometric Holds
exercises.notes: Front, back, left, right. Use hands lightly and keep tension smooth.

exercises.name: 9. Shadowboxing Conditioning Intervals
exercises.notes: Hard rounds at RPE 8, easy rounds at RPE 3–4. Stay crisp, fast, and technical.

exercises.name: 10. Easy Cooldown Walk and Nasal Breathing
exercises.notes: Bring heart rate down gradually. Relax shoulders and slow breathing.
